Practised multiplying numbers ending in zeros by multiplying non-zero parts and counting zeros.
Estimated large-number products by rounding first.
Rudra correctly estimated 6,180 × 480 as about ₹30,00,000.
Miscounted zeros in an exact product such as 3,000 × 400; this was not corrected by the last seen response.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Rudra practised separating non-zero parts from zeros and rounding numbers before estimating products. They explained the rounding steps for 6,180 × 480 and gave an estimate of ₹30,00,000. There was still a mix-up when counting zeros in an exact multiplication, and it was not corrected in the final response. At home, practise a few examples such as 3,000 × 400 by multiplying 3 × 4 first, then attaching all five zeros.
